requirements.title: Requirement 1: Install and Maintain Network Security Controls

controls.mandate_text: All security policies and operational procedures that are identified in Requirement 1 are documented, kept up to date, in use, and known to all affected parties.

controls.title_en: Roles and Responsibilities for Managing NSCs
controls.mandate_text: Roles and responsibilities for performing activities in Requirement 1 are documented, assigned, and understood by responsible personnel.
Configurations of network security controls (NSCs) are formalized, documented, and approved via established change management procedures.
Current network diagrams exist that document all connections between the cardholder data environment (CDE) and other networks, including wireless networks.
Current data flow diagrams exist that illustrate all cardholder data flows across systems and networks, kept up to date and verified periodically.
Vendor-owned or vendor-managed systems connecting to the network are secured according to organizational NSC requirements and approved.

controls.title_en: Services, Protocols, and Ports Approved & Justified
controls.mandate_text: All services, protocols, and ports allowed through NSCs are documented, justified with a defined business need, and approved.
Security features are defined and implemented for all insecure services, protocols, and ports in use (e.g., encapsulating cleartext traffic in SSH, TLS, or IPSec).
Configurations and rule sets of network security controls are reviewed at least once every six months to verify business necessity and validate that unauthorized rules are removed.
Network security control configuration files are protected from unauthorized access, alteration, and maintained in secure, versioned storage.

controls.title_en: Restrict Inbound Traffic to the CDE
controls.mandate_text: Inbound traffic to the cardholder data environment is restricted to only traffic that is necessary; all other inbound traffic is specifically denied.

controls.title_en: Restrict Outbound Traffic from the CDE
controls.mandate_text: Outbound traffic from the cardholder data environment is restricted to only traffic that is necessary; all other outbound traffic is specifically denied.

controls.title_en: Isolation Between Wireless Networks and the CDE
controls.mandate_text: Network security controls are implemented between all wireless networks and the CDE, denying all wireless traffic by default unless authorized and encrypted.

controls.title_en: NSCs Between Untrusted and Trusted Networks
controls.mandate_text: Network security controls are implemented between all untrusted networks and trusted system components within the corporate network and CDE.

controls.title_en: Restricting Inbound Traffic from Untrusted Networks
controls.mandate_text: Inbound traffic from untrusted networks to trusted systems is restricted to communications with components authorized to provide publicly accessible services.
Anti-spoofing measures are implemented to detect and block forged IP source addresses from entering the trusted network (e.g., blocking RFC 1918 traffic from the public Internet).

controls.title_en: Prohibit Direct Internet Routing to Private Addresses
controls.mandate_text: System components that store cardholder data or sensitive authentication data are not directly accessible from untrusted networks using public IP addresses (NAT/DMZ required).

controls.title_en: Prohibit Direct Connection to Internal Databases
controls.mandate_text: Direct public inbound access to databases or internal storage holding cardholder data from the Internet is prohibited. Intermediate web/app tiers must mediate access.

controls.title_en: Security Controls on Portable & Remote Devices
controls.mandate_text: Security controls are implemented on all computing devices that connect to both untrusted networks and the CDE to protect against unauthorized compromise.
